span.p:
AP1 — Served-flag state (#185 METHOD) — every prior
census read the DEFAULT; nobody diffed it against what
the server actually SERVED

span.p:
[served-config-cache] in ~/.claude.json
540 features on this account.
The client's own record of the values
the server returned to it

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
THE GAP: severity was always assigned from the
in-binary default, i.e. 'what if nobody touches it'.
Wrong question for a server-controlled channel

div.style: color: rgb(254, 205, 211) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
17 of 55 new DEFAULT-FALSE gates are SERVED TRUE.
Four are model-context-injection candidates:
[artifact-comments-gate], [comment-source-order-gate],
[comment-autoreact-gate], [vellum-gate]

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Inverse check CLEAN: of 74 default-TRUE bools only
3 are served false ([startup-toggle],
[outgoing-header-source-gate],
[session-name-collision-gate]) — none a permission
decision

div.style: color: rgb(254, 205, 211) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
It REVERSED a severity call. #182 filed High,
downgraded to Low on a two-flag-chain argument,
RESTORED to High when the cache showed BOTH
[cross-session-messaging-gate] and
[sender-asserted-mode-gate] served true

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Caveats: one account + one machine; a cache can be
stale; ABSENT is not 'served false' (absent = the code
default applies). 17 flags are absent, not off
